schema.text: How do the quality and availability of pedestrian crossings (e.g., zebra crossings, pedestrian signals, or crossing islands) affect your journey?

options.text: Crossings are well placed and I feel safe using them
Crossings exist but I often feel rushed or uncertain while using them
Crossings are too infrequent and I sometimes have to cross in unsafe places
The poor quality or lack of crossings forces me to significantly change my route
I avoid certain roads entirely because I cannot cross them safely on foot

it.#How do the quality and availability of: In che modo la qualità e la disponibilità degli attraversamenti pedonali (ad es. strisce pedonali, semafori pedonali o isole salvagente) influenzano il tuo spostamento?
it.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: Gli attraversamenti sono ben posizionati e mi sento al sicuro quando li utilizzo
it.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: Gli attraversamenti sono presenti, ma spesso mi sento sotto pressione o insicuro/a mentre li utilizzo
it.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: Gli attraversamenti sono troppo distanti tra loro e a volte devo attraversare in punti non sicuri
it.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: La scarsa qualità o la mancanza di attraversamenti mi costringe a modificare significativamente il percorso
it.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: Evito completamente alcune strade perché non posso attraversarle in sicurezza a piedi

fr.#How do the quality and availability of: Comment la qualité et la disponibilité des passages piétons, par exemple passages zébrés, feux piétons ou îlots centraux, influencent-elles votre trajet ?
fr.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: Les traversées sont bien placées et je me sens en sécurité en les utilisant
fr.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: Il y a des traversées, mais je me sens souvent pressé(e) ou peu sûr(e) quand je les utilise
fr.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: Les traversées sont trop rares et je dois parfois traverser à des endroits peu sûrs
fr.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: Le mauvais état ou le manque de traversées m’oblige à changer fortement mon itinéraire
fr.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: J’évite complètement certaines routes parce que je ne peux pas les traverser à pied en sécurité

de.#How do the quality and availability of: Wie beeinflussen Qualität und Verfügbarkeit von Fußgängerquerungen, zum Beispiel Zebrastreifen, Fußgängerampeln oder Mittelinseln, Ihren Weg?
de.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: Die Querungen liegen gut und ich fühle mich dort sicher
de.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: Es gibt Querungen, aber ich fühle mich dort oft unter Zeitdruck oder unsicher
de.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: Es gibt zu wenige Querungen und ich muss manchmal an unsicheren Stellen die Straße überqueren
de.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: Schlechte oder fehlende Querungen zwingen mich, meine Route deutlich zu ändern
de.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: Ich meide bestimmte Straßen ganz, weil ich sie zu Fuß nicht sicher überqueren kann

tr.#How do the quality and availability of: Yaya geçitlerinin kalitesi ve bulunabilirliği, örneğin yaya geçitleri, yaya sinyalleri veya orta refüjler, yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: Geçitler iyi yerlerde ve kullanırken kendimi güvende hissediyorum
tr.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: Geçitler var ama kullanırken sık sık acele etmek zorunda veya kararsız hissediyorum
tr.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: Geçitler çok seyrek; bazen güvensiz yerlerden karşıya geçmek zorunda kalıyorum
tr.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: Geçitlerin kötü olması veya hiç olmaması güzergâhımı önemli ölçüde değiştirmeme neden oluyor
tr.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: Yaya olarak güvenli şekilde karşıya geçemediğim için bazı yollardan tamamen kaçınıyorum

fa.#How do the quality and availability of: کیفیت و تعداد گذرگاه‌های عابر، مانند خط عابر، چراغ عابر یا جزیره میانی، چگونه بر سفر شما اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: گذرگاه‌ها جای مناسبی دارند و هنگام استفاده احساس امنیت می‌کنم
fa.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: گذرگاه هست، اما هنگام عبور اغلب احساس عجله یا عدم اطمینان می‌کنم
fa.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: گذرگاه‌ها کم هستند و گاهی مجبورم از محل ناامن عبور کنم
fa.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: کیفیت پایین یا نبود گذرگاه مجبورم می‌کند مسیرم را به‌طور قابل توجهی تغییر دهم
fa.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: بعضی خیابان‌ها را کاملاً کنار می‌گذارم چون نمی‌توانم با خیال راحت از آن‌ها عبور کنم

hu.#How do the quality and availability of: Hogyan befolyásolja az utazását a gyalogos átkelőhelyek minősége és elérhetősége, például zebra, gyalogos jelzőlámpa vagy középsziget?
hu.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: Az átkelőhelyek jó helyen vannak, és biztonságban érzem magam használat közben
hu.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: Vannak átkelőhelyek, de gyakran siettetve vagy bizonytalannak érzem magam használat közben
hu.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: Túl kevés az átkelőhely, ezért néha nem biztonságos helyen kell átkelnem
hu.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: A rossz minőségű vagy hiányzó átkelőhelyek miatt jelentősen módosítanom kell az útvonalamat
hu.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: Teljesen elkerülök bizonyos utakat, mert nem tudok biztonságosan átkelni gyalog

ar.#How do the quality and availability of: كيف تؤثر جودة وتوفر معابر المشاة، مثل ممرات المشاة أو إشارات المشاة أو الجزر الوسطية، في رحلتك؟
ar.#Crossings are well placed and I feel sa: المعابر في أماكن مناسبة وأشعر بالأمان عند استخدامها
ar.#Crossings exist but I often feel rushed: توجد معابر، لكنني أشعر غالبًا بالعجلة أو عدم الثقة عند استخدامها
ar.#Crossings are too infrequent and I some: المعابر قليلة جدًا وأضطر أحيانًا إلى العبور من أماكن غير آمنة
ar.#The poor quality or lack of crossings f: سوء جودة المعابر أو غيابها يجبرني على تغيير طريقي بشكل كبير
ar.#I avoid certain roads entirely because: أتجنب بعض الطرق تمامًا لأنني لا أستطيع عبورها بأمان سيرًا على الأقدام
